cues.en: Instructor: So we left off in the previous video with this tantalizing result that when we compress the spikes dataset down to two components,
cues.zh: 講師：上一支結束時，spikes 資料壓成兩個，

cues.en: two principle components, we seem to get this really strong clustering.
cues.zh: 兩個主成分後，出現很強的分群，很吸引人。

cues.en: So it looks like there's two clusters here.
So that brings us to this unsupervised learning challenge.
So what you want to do here is apply K means clustering to this dataset.
So not to the original data in the 12-dimensional space, but K means clustering on this reduced dimensional space.
cues.zh: 不是原始十二維資料，而是降維後的空間。

cues.en: So just on this PC1, PC2 space, and that is going to give you a label for each data point.
cues.zh: 只用 PC1、PC2，取得各資料點標籤。

cues.en: So each data point will be labeled as being group one or group two, or category one or category two.
cues.zh: 標為第一組或第二組、第一類或第二類。

cues.en: Here we can call it neuron one and neuron two, and then once you get that, you want to go back to these data.
cues.zh: 這裡可叫神經元一與二，取得後，回原始資料。

cues.en: So then you go back to the raw data, and you want to create two time courses.
cues.zh: 回到原資料，建立兩條時間歷程。

cues.en: So this was one time course averaging together all the spikes.
cues.zh: 之前是全部脈衝平均成一條。

cues.en: You want to now create two time courses that are separately averaging together.
cues.zh: 現在分別平均，建立兩條。

cues.en: The spikes in cluster one and the spikes in cluster two.
cues.zh: 第一群脈衝，以及第二群脈衝。

cues.en: Those are gonna have two different waveform shapes, and you'll be able to see what those two different neurons look like.
cues.zh: 波形會不同，能看見兩種神經元的樣子。

cues.en: So I hope you enjoy this.
I hope you take this opportunity to make a really cool-looking graphic, make a really nice visualization, and post it to the Q and A.
cues.zh: 把握機會，做漂亮圖表、視覺化，貼問答區。

cues.en: I would love to see what you've come up with.
